newsitem.title: USA: CSCE world sugar ends lower, prices seen falling.
newsitem.headline: CSCE world sugar ends lower, prices seen falling.

text.p: CSCE world sugar futures settled near the day's lows in what at least one broker described as "painfully slow" dealings.
Today's volume was estimated at only 6,964 lots.
Prices rose early but fell in the afternoon on aggressive trade selling. Mixed scale-down buying kept March from falling to major support pegged at 10.29.
The market remains in its recent trading range as March was unable to reach Thursday's high and resistance seen at 10.50.
"If it goes down further it will go point by point because everyone is just buying scale down," a broker said.
He added that the market has some strength basis May/July.
The spot-March contract closed down 0.02 to 10.35, having ranged from 10.47 to 10.34. The back months settled 0.01 lower to 0.02 firmer.
Open interest in March fell 756 lots to 85,473 lots.
